description: Shared MVR→laari parity table for POS Math.round(n*100) and App\Support\LaariConverter::toLaar. Negatives are legal in LaariConverter (refunds/adjustments).

known_divergences.note: IEEE754: 1.005*100 → 100.4999… so Math.round and PHP float-fallback give 100; bcmath half-up on exact 1.005 gives 101. Do not silently pick a winner — needs a product decision.
